# Campaign results — pooled per run (generated by render_results.py)

Campaigns `meas-ci:interactive:2026-09-22` (`chrome` from run #438 under D65), `meas-ci:interactive:2026-09-25` (`code` from run #566 under D72, keys only, every one of the recording's 44 windows) and `meas-ci:playback:2026-09-22` (`webrtc` from run #245), the three applications D51, D53 and D54 re-measured after the six (D55) — every repeat on one AMD EPYC 7763 under the machine gate (D26), pinned to one CPU (pin.sh; method §4). Components are identified by process role and comm (D67); the build is pinned for `code` and stated per repeat for `chrome` and `webrtc` (D69). `chrome` leaves out the duplicated copy of window 16 (D66) and its two per-input values are carried at the recording's 38 windows (D32, D68); `code` leaves out the later of the two copies of window 42 that two pushes ten seconds apart both measured (D66) and its two per-input values are carried at the recording's 44 windows (D32, D68), window 43 recording no event and running the idle phase alone.

Numbers are pooled over the repeats listed with each application; its phase lengths are the method's, §2 and the settles and phases §9's amendments name. `spread` is the range of the per-repeat p50. Threads are the top five by CPU. Per-input rules are method §5's (a) first-wake, (b) window minus idle rate, (c) waker (X-server-woken schedule-ins). Runner: `ubuntu-24.04`, 4 vCPU, kernel per `reports/*.spec.json`.
